name: The Ash Sample Court
prompt: Build a volcanic observatory around rows of white ash-collection trays. Researchers compare bands of dark fallout while a crane lowers a fresh tray beyond the shelter.

name: The Moving Floor
prompt: Place a large suspended seismograph over a slowly turning paper drum. A visitor gallery looks down on the trace, and technicians carry the finished strip into a map room.

name: A Crater in Miniature
prompt: Build a terraced physical crater model at an observatory teaching court. Researchers pour coloured water into mapped gullies and follow it into separate catch basins.

name: The Fumarole Orchestra
prompt: Carry steam from a cluster of miniature field vents to visible condensing coils. Scientists collect droplets in glass receivers while visitors cross a raised observation bridge.

name: The Stone Thermometer
prompt: Arrange insulated probes and ceramic sample racks beneath a volcanology field awning. A researcher draws a glowing sample into a cooling box beside a tray of blackened older stones.
